stem: A harvest cart suddenly requires much more force to start moving because one wheel is damaged. What is the strongest first response?
choices: Apply the RNLE because the cart has a known weight
Remove the cart from service or repair the wheel, then reassess the pushing task
Ask two workers to push harder without changing the equipment
Reduce the number of bins but continue using the damaged cart
rationale: A damaged wheel is an equipment defect increasing push force; correcting the equipment addresses the source and RNLE is not the appropriate equation for pushing.
